items.a: Your data is stored on your device first, then synced to servers located in the European Union. Traffic is encrypted (TLS), attachments are kept in a private space and each account can only access its own data. We never sell or share your data.

The logbook records all the information required by FCL.050 in the AMC1 FCL.050 layout. Night time follows the EASA definition (civil twilight). An electronic logbook is acceptable provided the data is accurate and available on request: you can print or show the official PDF export at any time.
Yes, anytime: PDF in EASA, FAA or CASA format, CSV and Excel. You can also download all your data as JSON from the settings.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: In one click from the settings (web) or from your store settings (iOS, Android). Your logbook stays readable and exportable after cancellation.

items.q: Can I bring my paper logbook?
items.a: Yes. Enter your paper logbook totals under “Carry forward”: they are added to your totals and shown as “Total from previous pages” in the export. You can also scan your pages or import a file.
Yes. Logging and browsing work offline. Sync resumes automatically once you're back online.

Not covered: augmented crew, unknown acclimatisation state, standby.

A flight in 20 seconds: Geardown computes block time, night, day/night landings and the single-pilot / multi-pilot columns.
PDF in EASA, FAA or CASA format, with page totals and carry-forward. Ready for a check ride or a job interview.

immersive.canvasLabel: Scroll-driven film: a business jet descends at dusk over a sea of clouds, goes through the layer, breaks out on final facing the runway and lowers its gear, then the Earth seen from space with flight routes, which you can turn.

c1.label: 01 · Night time
c1.title: The sun drops below −6°. Geardown logs it.
c1.text: EASA night begins at the end of evening civil twilight. Geardown follows the aircraft's position minute by minute and works out night time, night takeoffs and night landings, with nothing for you to type.

machine.label: 02 · Your logbook
machine.title: Your {name}. The right columns, automatically.
machine.text: Geardown knows your type: every flight feeds the right columns of your logbook, EASA, FAA or CASA, the totals by type and your recent experience.

c2.label: 03 · Your routes
c2.title: Every flight, on the world map.
c2.text: Your routes drawn as great circles across 19,000 aerodromes. Hours by type, by function, at night and IFR: your career at a glance.

c3.label: 04 · Compliance
c3.title: Ready for the check ride.
c3.text: Automatic logbook audit, licences and medical tracked, FTL limits, official EASA, FAA or CASA PDF export. Your logbook is right, and you can prove it.
